receipts.title: Project receipts
receipts.subtitle: View, download, and track email delivery for receipts from your completed projects.
receipts.emptyDescription: A receipt will appear here when one of your projects is completed.
receipts.downloadError: The receipt PDF could not be downloaded.
receipts.prepareError: The receipt could not be prepared.
receipts.retryError: The receipt could not be retried.
receipts.generationRetryQueued: Receipt generation has been queued again.
receipts.emailRetryQueued: Receipt email delivery has been queued again.
receipts.queuedAfterCompletion: Project completed. Your receipt is being prepared and will be emailed to you.
receipts.prepareWarning: Project completed, but the receipt could not be queued yet. Open the completed project to retry.
receipts.automaticEmailDescription: A PDF copy will be emailed automatically when it is ready.
receipts.emailedDescription: A PDF copy was sent to the email address on your GigBridge account.
receipts.preparingDescription: The PDF is being generated. This view updates automatically, and the receipt will be emailed when ready.
